title: Expiry and recall
description: Expiry and recall for a pharmacy, a grocery or any shop that sells lots with an expiry date. A recall notice (the regulator's reference, its class, depth and clock) lists the lots; Block these batches, pressed by a Recall Officer, switches each lot off at every till and store at once (Batch disabled), reads the stock ledger to find each store's stock, and, at consumer depth, the customers already supplied from the sales that moved the lot, writes both onto the notice and makes a Store Progress record per store for its staff. A lot with no expiry date is never saved by the app (the shop would write a guessed date into it): it is listed instead. Recalled and expired stock moves to a quarantine store by the shop's own transfer; a stock entry that disposes of a scheduled item (an issue, or stock leaving quarantine, or a blocked or expired lot, for anywhere but quarantine) is refused unless it names a Disposal Record for that store with the regulator's visit recorded (officer, authority, date, signed form) and locked, whose lines still cover it; a stock count may not dispose of such stock. An Expiry Worklist lists lots expiring within the shop's window, per store, and medicine lots with no expiry date. A goods receipt is refused when a lot has fewer days left (from today, or the posting date if later) than the shop's minimum, unless its line has a Letter of Undertaking with its days; an expired lot always; a lot of an item with a shelf life until the pack's expiry is typed on the line; and a receipt with no supplier's invoice number when the settings ask for one. Receipts and stock entries posted by the ERP connector's own user are not refused for what they hold (SAP brings its receipts and disposals as stock entries): the problems are written into the receipt's Receiving check field or the entry's ERP check field. While the service does not answer, receipts, stock entries and stock counts wait (they are refused), the ERP connector's included: its sync stops until the service answers again. Not yet: a Desk document that names a blocked lot by hand is not refused until the POS app refuses disabled lots on every stock document; an offline till keeps a blocked lot until it syncs. Sent to the service: a notice's name, class, depth, dates and lots; a worklist's name, store and window; a receipt's name, supplier, date, return flag, supplier's note and its lines' item, quantities, lot, bundle, pack expiry and Letter of Undertaking; a stock entry's name, purpose, date, disposal record and its lines' item, quantities, stores, lot and bundle; a stock count's name, purpose, date and its lines' item, store, quantities, lot and bundles. The install makes the roles PP RCL Integration and PP RCL Recall Officer; the shop gives the integration role read on Item, Serial and Batch Bundle, POS Invoice, Sales Invoice, Delivery Note, Stock Entry and Retail Save Rule, and read and write on Batch, switches on the five save rules and leaves the feed PP RCL Recall feed off; the install gives the integration role to the app's own user. allowed_urls is the programme bench's address; a partner writes its own.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: The service reads the record named Default.

fields.label: Hours from UTC at the shop
fields.description: Your site's own time zone (System Settings), so the app's dates and times read as the shop's: 3 for Nairobi or Riyadh, 4 for Dubai, 1 for Lagos, 2 for Cairo, -6 for Mexico City. Blank: UTC.

fields.label: Minimum shelf life at receipt (days)
fields.description: A lot received with fewer days left is refused unless its line has a Letter of Undertaking. An item may set its own. Blank or 0: no minimum (an expired lot is still refused).

fields.label: Supplier's invoice or credit-note number required
fields.description: Supplier Delivery Note must be filled on every receipt and return. Untick it if you receive on Handheld, whose receipt cannot send it.

fields.label: ERP users (one per line)
fields.description: The users your ERP connector posts receipts as, and nobody's own login: their receipts are not refused for what they hold, the problems are written in the receipt's Receiving check field instead.

fields.label: Pack expiry required where the item has a shelf life
fields.description: With a shelf life set, the shop can work a lot's expiry out from its manufacturing date, so the line must carry the date printed on the pack. Untick it if you receive on Handheld, which cannot send it: then only an expiry that equals manufacturing date plus shelf life is asked for.

fields.label: Near-expiry window (days)
fields.description: An Expiry Worklist lists lots that expire within these days. A worklist may set its own.

fields.label: Quarantine stores (one per line)
fields.description: Recalled and expired stock is moved into one of these with a stock transfer. Stock leaving one, other than into another, is a disposal.

fields.label: Recall clocks (from when the notice is received)
The regulator's visit is needed for
fields.options:
Items with a listed schedule
Every disposal
No disposal
fields.description: Items with a listed schedule reads each item's schedules (Pharmacy counter rules). A disposal is refused, never let through, when the item has no such field.

fields.label: Schedules that need the visit (one per line)
fields.description: Blank: any schedule.

fields.label: Item field holding the schedules
fields.description: The field Pharmacy counter rules adds to Item: a table of schedules, or a field naming one.

fields.label: Issued by
fields.description: Such as PPB, NAFDAC, the FDA (Ghana), EDA.

fields.label: Class
fields.options:
Class I
Class II
Class III

fields.label: Depth
fields.description: Blank: the class's depth in the settings. Customers are traced at consumer depth only.

fields.label: Start by
fields.description: Blank: worked out from the class's clock in the settings at the first press.

fields.label: Quantity found
fields.description: Set by the app at each press of Block these batches, from the stock ledger.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
To do
In progress
Done
Nothing to do

fields.label: Reason
fields.options:
Expired
Recalled
Damaged
Patient return
Other

fields.label: Regulator notified on
fields.description: Where the regulator must be told before the destruction (Jordan: expired narcotics), the day it was.

fields.label: Authority
fields.description: Such as PPB, the Dubai Health Authority's inspection team, JFDA, COFEPRIS.

fields.label: How it was destroyed or returned
fields.description: Such as returned to the central medical stores, incinerated by a licensed contractor.

fields.label: Action
fields.options:
To check
Marked down
Returned to supplier
Moved to quarantine

fields.label: Store
fields.description: Blank: every store.

fields.label: Window (days)
fields.description: Blank: the settings' near-expiry window.

fields.label: Medicine lots with no expiry date
No expiry date
fields.description: Enter the date printed on the pack, then enable the lot, unless it is on a recall notice: that lot stays blocked.

custom_fields.label: Minimum shelf life at receipt (days)
custom_fields.description: Blank: the shop's minimum in Expiry and recall's settings.

custom_fields.label: Shelf-life check exempt
custom_fields.description: A receipt of this item is not held to a minimum shelf life. An expired lot is still refused.

custom_fields.label: Pack expiry
custom_fields.description: The expiry date printed on the pack. Needed when the lot's expiry could have been worked out from its manufacturing date and shelf life.

custom_fields.label: Letter of Undertaking
custom_fields.description: The supplier undertakes for short-dated stock: the lot is accepted if it has at least the days below left.

custom_fields.label: Receiving check (ERP receipts)
custom_fields.description: Filled by Expiry and recall on a receipt your ERP posted: what a Desk receipt would have been refused for.

custom_fields.label: ERP check
custom_fields.description: Filled by Expiry and recall on a stock entry your ERP connector posted (SAP's receipts and disposals arrive as stock entries): what it would have refused on the Desk.

custom_fields.label: Disposal record
custom_fields.description: An issue that disposes of controlled stock names its disposal record, with the regulator's visit recorded.
